scientific_question: Which ingredients of the shipped Socratic Method (soft anti-aliased targets, separation shell, M7-KL anchor, crest recall, trust region) still earn their place on the 12-scroll wide corpus, where the jackpot recipe already produced the best held-out macro ever but is chonky at its calibrated threshold? Every shipped term's prior evidence is from a 1-scroll 4,096-row corpus with a saturated 16x trust region; none has been measured with breadth or without the projection binding.

base.note: Verbatim the wide15 jackpot recipe (m7_xr_wide15_jackpot_recipe_20260901.json) except targets and per-arm objective deltas. Declared at max_train_samples 250000 so the poly(0.9) LR trajectory is IDENTICAL to A0 (train.py:974: poly horizon = max_train_samples); the runner terminates each arm once the 50k milestone is durable.

corpus.soft_contract: STITCHED soft corpus: 10,072 native rows rebuilt at exact source origins via the cuda-gauss-hermite3 anti-aliased pullback (teacher_q + target_valid sidecars); 6,128 human rows pass through with their original hard targets (already 1-2 vox thin; the loader synthesizes binary q=(target==1)*255 where the sidecar is absent; the CUDA GH3 backend does not cover human general-affine records - measured 2026-09-01, they route to scipy-tiled-gaussian and reproject refuses mixed backends). Manifest row order byte-for-byte the source order.

operator_controls.reason: Run and evaluate exactly B0r, C1, and C3 after the reviewed B0 result, then stop before any conditional or combo arm launches.

decision_rules.winner: highest val calibrated macro among arms passing blind gates at their calibrated threshold; if the val-best fails gates, promote the next passer; if none pass, ladder returns no-gate-passer and the D phase becomes exploratory -- never calibrate against PHerc1447
decision_rules.tie_margin: max(0.005, 2x RMS of B0-vs-B0r matched-milestone macro deltas); ties go to fewer loss terms
decision_rules.scroll_guard: winner must not fall below released M7 on either val scroll individually
decision_rules.human_review: PNGs can veto a winner, never pick one
decision_rules.arm_score: best of the arm's five milestones by calibrated macro on the fixed val manifest; A0 scored at fixed 50k -- asymmetry favors arms and fixed-30k/50k tables are reported alongside

d_phase.combo_confirm: B0 + surviving terms at 50k, must score >= best single arm minus the tie margin; if the surviving set equals an existing arm, that arm IS the combo (no retrain)
d_phase.final: 100k+ run of the confirmed recipe -- HARD STOP before this stage for operator review (user-chosen autonomy: auto through combo)

final_ablation.directive: operator goal 2026-09-01 evening: once the best-shot model exists, ablate it (a) against vanilla released M7, (b) against vanilla released M7 + 8-way mirror TTA, (c) per component isolation

baselines.harness: audit-checkpoint on the fixed val manifest + blind six-cube report vs the jackpot reference, no TTA
same harness with 8-way mirror TTA at audit and report time

component_isolation.rule: every component of the winning recipe must have an isolation measurement under the frozen harness: target operator via A0-vs-B0; each loss term via its single-term arm vs B0; if the winner is a combo of >=2 terms, leave-one-out arms (winner minus each term, 50k, same seed) for any component whose isolation is not already implied by the committed arms (for a 2-term combo the leave-one-outs ARE the single-term arms -- no retrain)
component_isolation.budget_note: new leave-one-out arms only for a >=3-component winner

final_ablation.deliverable: one table: winner + per-component deltas + M7 raw + M7 TTA, all under the frozen harness, with blind-report PNGs for eyes
